title: Build Attempt 2026-07-17

canonical_node.axiom: A clean source-only build of the Theophysics Lean repository is a necessary condition for verifying that the project compiles without source-level errors.
definitions: Clean source-only build: a build performed from a fresh checkout without pre-existing build artifacts, using the specified Lean/Lake toolchain.
Source-level error: a type error, proof error, or syntax error in the Lean source files that prevents compilation.
Manual stop: an intentional interruption of the build process by the user, not a build failure.
derivation: The document reports the command 'lake build' executed in the specified working directory.
The toolchain versions are listed: Lake 5.0.0-src+b4812ae, Lean 4.32.0-rc1.
The build resolved dependencies and began compiling project modules.
Several Theophysics modules built successfully before the run was manually stopped.
Warnings were observed but no source-level error was displayed before the manual stop.
The later 'Lean exited with code 4294967295' messages were attributed to manually stopping child processes, not to a displayed type/proof error.
canonical_node.action: Run the build from a local SSD checkout or with dependency caches materialized to obtain a clean, complete build log for professional review.
boundary: This document does not claim that the entire project builds successfully; the build was stopped before completion.
This document does not claim that all modules compile; only a subset of modules were observed to build.
This document does not provide a full build log or a final exit code from a completed build.
test: Execute 'lake build' in a clean local SSD checkout and verify that the command completes with exit code 0.
Check that all Theophysics modules compile without source-level errors.
Compare the set of successfully built modules against the list reported in this document.

dg1_dependencies: Network drive or local SSD for storage
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides evidence that a subset of Theophysics modules compile under the specified toolchain, and identifies a practical recommendation for obtaining a complete build.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: The claim that no source-level error was observed before manual stop is preserved; the document does not assert a full successful build.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If this document is removed, the record of a partial build attempt and the recommendation for a local SSD build would be lost, but the underlying source code and toolchain remain unchanged.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Record as a build attempt log; do not treat as a proof of full compilation.

overstatement_risks: Interpreting the partial build as evidence that the entire project compiles.
Treating the absence of displayed errors before manual stop as a guarantee of no errors in unbuilt modules.
Ignoring the manual stop and the incomplete nature of the build.
kill_conditions: If a subsequent complete build reveals source-level errors in modules not built here.
If the toolchain version is not reproducible.
If the working directory or source code is not available for verification.
risk.lean_target: A complete, clean build log from a local SSD checkout with exit code 0.

plain_summary: This document reports a partial build attempt of the Theophysics Lean project. Several modules compiled successfully before the build was manually stopped due to slow network-drive performance. No source-level errors were observed, but the build was not completed, so it does not prove the entire project compiles. The recommendation is to run the build on a local SSD for a full audit.
